tips.title: Practice one layout.
tips.body: Choose a layout your team can rebuild. Use it again with different articles and photos.
tips.practice: Notice how the main story stays on the left and smaller stories sit beside it.
tips.alt: GMA homepage showing its menu, large lead story, and smaller supporting stories.

tips.title: Make the main story bigger.
tips.body: Give your lead story a bigger photo and headline. Keep the other stories smaller.
tips.practice: CNN gives one story much more space than the stories beside it.
tips.alt: CNN Sports page showing a large lead photo and smaller story previews.

tips.title: Keep the menu simple.
tips.body: Use clear section names: News, Editorial, Feature, and Sports. Put the menu where readers can find it.
tips.practice: GMA places its section names together in one row.
tips.alt: GMA homepage showing its menu, large lead story, and smaller supporting stories.

tips.title: Choose fonts and sizes early.
tips.body: Start with two fonts. Make headlines large, article text comfortable to read, and captions smaller.
tips.practice: You can tell the headline, body, and caption apart without reading them.

tips.title: Stick to a few colors.
tips.body: Choose one main color with dark text and a light background. Repeat those colors across the site.
tips.practice: GMA repeats red in section labels while keeping most text dark.
tips.alt: GMA homepage showing its menu, large lead story, and smaller supporting stories.

tips.title: Use photos that tell the story.
tips.body: Pick a clear photo of the action or person in the article. Add an accurate caption and credit.
tips.practice: The large sports photo shows the players and their expressions.
tips.alt: CNN Sports page showing a large lead photo and smaller story previews.

tips.title: Turn numbers into a simple graphic.
tips.body: Use a bar chart for a comparison. Add labels and say where the numbers came from.
tips.practice: The longer bar shows the higher score. Both bars use the same scale.

tips.title: Show a preview, then the full story.
tips.body: On a section page, show the photo, headline, and a short preview. Let readers click to open the article.
tips.practice: CNN shows several linked story previews instead of full articles.
tips.alt: CNN Sports page showing a large lead photo and smaller story previews.

tips.title: Everyone should know basic layout.
tips.body: Teach every member to add text, photos, and captions. The layout artist should not do everything alone.
tips.practice: Each person handles a small part. One person checks the final design.

tips.title: Prepare angles before practice.
tips.body: Practice different ways to tell a story. During the contest, choose the angle your facts and interviews support.
tips.practice: The same event can lead to news, a feature, or an editorial.
